00045 static const double randomFactor = 1.0 / RAND_MAX;
00046 
00047 const float NeuralNodeSimpleInternal::defaultWeight = 0.1;
00048 const float NeuralNodeSimpleInternal::ne1 = (float)e1;
00049 const float NeuralNodeSimpleInternal::one = (float)1.0;
00050 const float NeuralNodeSimpleInternal::zero = (float)0.0;

00052 NeuralNodeSimpleInternal::NeuralNodeSimpleInternal(const int numWeights) throw()
00053 :   threshold(zero), output(zero), //input(zero), act(zero),
00054     weightVector(NumericalArray<float>::newClear(numWeights < 1 ? 1 : numWeights))
00055 {       
00056     init(defaultWeight);
00057 }

00059 void NeuralNodeSimpleInternal::init(const float weightMaximum) throw()
00060 {
00061     threshold = std::rand() * randomFactor * 2 * weightMaximum - weightMaximum;
00062     
00063     for(int i = 0; i < weightVector.size(); i++)
00064     {
00065         weightVector[i] = std::rand() * randomFactor * 2 * weightMaximum - weightMaximum;
00066     }   
00067 }
00068 
00069 void NeuralNodeSimpleInternal::randomise(const float amount) throw()
00070 {
00071     threshold += std::rand() * randomFactor * 2 * amount - amount;
00072     
00073     for(int i = 0; i < weightVector.size(); i++)
00074     {
00075         weightVector[i] += std::rand() * randomFactor * 2 * amount - amount;
00076     }   
00077 }

00104 float NeuralNodeSimpleInternal::propogate(NumericalArray<float> const& inputVector) throw()
00105 {
00106     float input = zero;
00107     
00108     const float* inputVectorPtr = inputVector.getArray();
00109     const float* weightVectorPtr = weightVector.getArray();
00110     
00111     const int size = weightVector.size();
00112     for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00113     {
00114         input += inputVectorPtr[i] * weightVectorPtr[i];
00115     }   
00116     
00117     float act = input + threshold;
00118     output = one / (one + (float)ugen::pow(ne1, -act));
00119     
00120     return output;
00121 }
00122 
00123 void NeuralNodeSimpleInternal::backProp(NumericalArray<float> const& inputVector, 
00124                                         const float error, const float actFuncOffset, const float learnRate, 
00125                                         NumericalArray<float>& adjustVector) throw()
00126 {
00127     float output = this->output;
00128     float adjust = error * (actFuncOffset + (output * (one-output)));
00129     float learn = adjust * learnRate;
00130     
00131     float* weightVectorPtr = weightVector.getArray();
00132     float* adjustVectorPtr = adjustVector.getArray();
00133     const float* inputVectorPtr = inputVector.getArray();
00134     
00135     const int size = weightVector.size();
00136     for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00137     {
00138         weightVectorPtr[i] += inputVectorPtr[i] * learn;
00139         adjustVectorPtr[i] += weightVectorPtr[i] * adjust;
00140     }
00141     
00142     threshold += learn;
00143 }
